method: Dense 6-frame contact sheets generated via ffmpeg from original source videos, visually inspected frame-by-frame
v0024_v0026_editorial_note: Excluded from deep review per Jane's editorial decision (2026-09-02). V0024/V0026 are not final-video A-roll candidates. Their transcripts remain project-intelligence sources.

summary.what_the_strongest_media_can_show: The strongest available footage clearly demonstrates: (1) the scale and curvature of the completed 106-foot curved LED wall with live multi-source sports content, (2) the bar ticker integrated into the sportsbook bar environment with patrons present, (3) the installation process with technicians working on lifts during the build, (4) the decommissioned legacy projectors removed from the rack room, and (5) the overall finished sportsbook environment with patrons using the space. The footage is heavily weighted toward completed hero reveals of the finished wall from multiple angles, with strong installation progress and decommissioning coverage.
summary.what_is_missing: No footage of the 2 LUCI racks that replaced the 15 legacy racks (only the 'before' decommissioning footage exists). No footage of the LUCI interface/iPad in operational use. No footage of wall configurations being switched. No customer/operator interview. No true 'before' footage of the old projector/screen sportsbook in operation (V0048 shows decommissioned projectors in storage, not the former setup running). No footage of the bar ticker under construction.
summary.strongest_available_media_can_show: The strongest available media demonstrates: (1) the scale and visual impact of the completed 106-foot curved LED wall (V0036, V0040, V0028, V0048 hero pans; I0065, I0066 hero stills), (2) the bar ticker under construction and during testing with test numbers (V0031, V0037 — Jane confirmed these are 'during' shots with testing data, not 'after'), (3) the rack room transformation — the 2-3 completed LUCI racks that replaced 15 legacy racks (V0051, V0050, V0052; I0078 LUCI IPTV ENCODER close-up), (4) LED panel installation with workers on lifts (V0027, V0028), (5) decommissioned legacy projectors and gear (V0048, V0053), (6) the completed sportsbook bar environment with integrated LED ticker (V0039, V0041, V0044), (7) construction/before context (V0020, V0021, V0006), (8) the completed high-limit lounge with LED wall (V0007), and (9) general property context from B-Roll — casino floor, food court with digital signage, bar with gaming terminals, hotel lobby with guests (V0010, V0004, V0002, V0014, V0016). The human-curated 5-photo construction progression (IMG_4216 → IMG_4872) remains a supporting editorial device.

redundancy_clusters.notes: V0036 best single hero pull-back. V0040 most comprehensive 27s journey. V0035 distinct (technicians in safety gear, commissioning phase).

redundancy_clusters.description: Rack room completed — the 2-3 LUCI racks that replaced the 15 legacy racks

redundancy_clusters.description: Bar ticker during construction/testing with test numbers on display
redundancy_clusters.notes: V0031 clearly shows the bar ticker with red/white test numbers (320, 280) — a 'during' shot, not 'after'. V0037 shows the wrap-around ticker with diagnostic test data in wider room context. Jane clarified: these are testing numbers, not final content.

redundancy_clusters.description: Rack room during installation — LUCI hardware being mounted
redundancy_clusters.notes: V0049 (33s) shows LUCI-branded units being installed with technician present — frame 5 at t=24.8s is clearest. V0045 (17.3s) shows cable management and equipment but less organized.

V0027 (13s) shows workers on boom lift and scissor lift installing LED modules (green test pattern). V0023 is a still image (IMG_4873.jpeg) of the LED ticker mounting frame under construction. Note: V0027 may show the main wall, not the bar ticker specifically — first-pass classification said 'ticker frame' but contact sheet suggests main wall.

redundancy_clusters.description: B-Roll property context — completed casino floor, food court, lounge/bar, hotel lobby
redundancy_clusters.notes: V0010 (casino bar with gaming terminals, sports on TV) and V0004 (food court with digital signage) are the strongest — they show LUCI-managed AV in operational context. V0002 (casino floor), V0014 (lobby fireplace), V0016 (lobby with guests) are good alternates. The rest are redundant within their categories (casino floor, food court, lounge, lobby).
